notablePrerequisites: Knotvine Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Knotvine Mystic by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Knotvine Mystic.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
